result_text:
The region overview now lists open tickets high priority first, then normal, then low, oldest first within each priority. Closed tickets and other regions are still excluded.

The change is one SQL line in `DataStore.listOpenSupportTicketsByRegion` (`src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`). I used the same `ORDER BY` as the sales rep's open-ticket query, and updated the Javadoc to match. That method is only called from `RegionManagerService.overviewFor`, so nothing else changes.

`RegionManagerTest`, `RegionReportTest`, `SupportTicketTest` and `TicketsPerSalesRepTest` pass offline. I did not add a test that checks the new ordering against your T-1 to T-5 example, so that case is verified only by reading the query. Nothing is committed.
